parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human D2 dopamine receptor (CHEMBL217) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL217 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
